{{Top|leg}}
'''Static discharge panels''' were capable of scrambling communication and subspace frequencies, blocking all communications between [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in a local area. [[Miradyne Limited]]'s [[4x-Phantom Short-Range Sensor Jammer/Legends|4x-Phantom Short-Range Sensor Jammer]] incorporated static discharge panels as part of its [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] suite.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
